title: Matt LaFleur on taking points off the board: We're gonna be aggressive, go for the throat

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Matt LaFleur on taking points off the board: We're gonna be aggressive, go for the throat
sources.description: The Packers continued a run of late-game meltdowns in Minnesota on Sunday afternoon and one of head coach Matt LaFleur's decision loomed large as they went from leading the Vikings to an 0-1 record.
